about.heroBody: BRC is a resource-based ministry in New Jersey, devoted to worship, prayer, and cross-cultural connection through events, training, and partnerships that serve cities and nations.
about.heroOrgNote: Bethel Renewal Center is an IRS-recognized 501(c)(3) non-profit organization.
about.storyBody: Bethel Resource Center (BRC), located in New Jersey, North America, is a resource center dedicated to building the Bride of Christ, with an affiliated worship and prayer room. We are committed to promoting worship and prayer initiatives and fostering connections among churches. We also assist churches and ministry organizations in hosting events, and welcome inquiries. Through wholehearted and fervent worship, praise, and prayer, we seek to go beyond form, generation, language, ethnicity, and denomination, pursuing unity in one accord. We long to live out a vibrant lifestyle of faith—rejoicing daily, walking in confidence, sharing the Gospel wherever we go, praying continually, and living in victory. We are called to carry the vision of worship and prayer everywhere and to unite with churches to rebuild the fallen tent of David together in one heart and purpose.

goals.title: Seek God's Kingdom and Righteousness
goals.verse: "But seek first his kingdom and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well."
goals.note: We do not plan our lives first and then ask God to bless them; we align with His kingdom and His will first.

goals.title: Commit Your Way to the Lord
goals.verse: "Trust in the LORD with all your heart and lean not on your own understanding; in all your ways submit to him, and he will make your paths straight."
goals.note: Alignment means surrendering our own control and letting God lead.

goals.title: Be Transformed by the Renewing of Your Mind
goals.verse: "Do not conform to the pattern of this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind. Then you will be able to test and approve what God's will is-his good, pleasing and perfect will."
goals.note: True alignment starts with renewing our way of thinking.

goals.title: The Lord Directs Our Steps
goals.verse: "The LORD makes firm the steps of the one who delights in him; he may stumble, but he will not fall, for the LORD upholds him with his hand."
goals.note: When we align with God, our steps are calibrated by Him.

goals.title: Obedience Brings Blessing
goals.verse: "If you fully obey the LORD your God and carefully follow all his commands... all these blessings will come on you and accompany you."
goals.note: Alignment is not a slogan; it is a life of obedience.

goals.title: Not My Will, but Yours
goals.verse: "Yet not my will, but yours be done."
goals.note: This is the deepest example of alignment with God.

goals.title: The Lord Is Our Foundation
goals.verse: "Unless the LORD builds the house, the builders labor in vain."
goals.note: Without aligning with God, even great effort can fall short.

morningGuide.title: How to Join Morning Prayer
morningGuide.subtitle: Key instructions are now available directly on this page.
schedule: Use the same Zoom entry to join
steps: Click the "Join Zoom Prayer" button to enter directly.
If Zoom is not installed, install the desktop/mobile app first.
Mute your microphone after joining, then unmute only when speaking.
Use a display name like "Region-Name" to help team coordination.
notes: Keep prayer concise and focused; avoid repeated wording or too many topics at once.
Try to keep each spoken prayer within 1-2 minutes.
After you pray, allow those who have not prayed yet to go first.
Due to system limitations, one person should pray at a time to reduce audio noise.
Besides receiving prayer topics, ask the Holy Spirit how to pray for each topic.
Listen to one another's prayers and discern together.
